note: Walked: landing, console, docs/cli, device login approval, CLI mount before/after login. Finder app is not installed on the Studio, so download, drag, extension, Finder row and drop-file steps are not-walkable. Mount fails with a raw ENOENT.

findings.criterion: mount with Finder app not installed
findings.description: Run `agent-drive mount /Users/agent/uxw/m051/AgentDrive` on a Mac without Agent Drive.app.
findings.expected: A message saying the Agent Drive Finder app is not installed, with the download link and the /Applications location.
findings.actual: Raw system error: "ENOENT: no such file or directory, stat '/Applications/Agent Drive.app/Contents/MacOS/AgentDriveFinder'". The same raw error comes from foreground `connect` after it already printed the saved-entry JSON, and from AGENT_DRIVE_FINDER_HELPER pointing at a missing file.
findings.evidence: CLI output quoted in walk-report.md step 5
findings.suggested_fix: Catch ENOENT on the helper path and print: 'Agent Drive Finder app not found at /Applications/Agent Drive.app. Download it from <release URL>, drag it to /Applications, or set AGENT_DRIVE_FINDER_HELPER.'

findings.description: Priya looks on the landing page, console and /llms.txt for 'Finder' or 'mount'.
findings.expected: Some pointer to the Finder mount from the console or the docs Quickstart.
findings.actual: Landing page, /console and /llms.txt contain no 'Finder', 'mount' or 'Instabox' text. Only /docs/cli mentions it, inside one dense paragraph of the Install section.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a short 'Mount in Finder' section to Quickstart and link it from the console; split the Finder paragraph in docs/cli into steps.

findings.description: Run `login --no-browser` with AGENT_DRIVE_API_URL=http://localhost:3811 (no /api suffix, as the walk brief said).
findings.expected: An error that names the URL tried and suggests the /api path.
findings.actual: "Agent Drive refused the login request: 404" with no URL shown. Works with .../api. Login also prints 'Ignored a different API URL returned by the server.' without explanation.
findings.suggested_fix: Include the request URL in the 404 message and hint that the API URL normally ends in /api.

findings.actual: `mounts list | status [NAME]` appears, then `mounts list` and `mounts status [NAME]` again later; mount, mounts add and mounts service lines are interleaved. Help never says what an Instabox sandbox ID is.
findings.suggested_fix: Dedupe the mounts lines and group drive mounts and live workspaces separately.
